name: Život Není Krásný: Poslední Exekuce
storyline:
Life is good — your name is Vladimír Brehowski, you’re 63 years old, you love booze, greasy food, and you never shy away from throwing a punch. You’re a seasoned bailiff, and today is your last day at work before retirement, which you plan to spend alongside your overweight wife Jitka.
But when you wake up with a massive hangover, you discover that Jitka is gone - she couldn’t stand your excessive drinking anymore and left behind only a farewell letter.

Instead of dealing with your marital crisis, you have to go to work - because your boss is an even bigger bastard than you are, and the only things he hates more than kindness and goodwill are disobedience and slacking. So you grab your bailiff gear and head out to brutally collect money from the most vulnerable - the socially unadaptable, the mentally slow, and even a little boy from an orphanage who inherited debt from his deceased parents. There’s nothing you can do - work is work, and the law is clear: you have to squeeze the money out of those poor souls no matter what!

The game Život Není Krásný: Poslední Exekuce loosely follows the cult ZNK game series. This time, however, under the direction of Marty Pohl, an experienced creative team took over development and elevated the originally freeware project into a full-fledged game. It’s a hand‑drawn, old‑school point‑and‑click adventure full of dark humor and politically incorrect violence.

The game features 40 playable screens and over 30 fully voiced characters. The main character is voiced by actor Leoš Noha, and the supporting cast includes Radim Neuvirt, Matěj Ruppert, Bruno Ferrari, Necrocock, James Cole, Hugo Toxxx, Zuzana Truplová, Oto Klempíř, and many more! Classic adventure gameplay is complemented by cutscenes and minigames - the bailiff sequences are especially spicy! And for sharp‑eyed players, there’s even a hidden second ending.

So - are you ready to help Brehowski with his “Last Execution”?
summary: A hand‑drawn, old‑school point‑and‑click adventure filled with dark humor and unapologetically over‑the‑top violence. Step into the shoes of the degenerate bailiff Vladimír Brehowski and follow him through his final day on the job.
